name: Penguin Solutions, Inc.
summary: Penguin Solutions, Inc., an AI factory platform company, designs, builds, deploys, and manages data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers in the United States, China, Europe, Mexico, and internationally. Its full-stack AI factory platform combines infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate AI adoption, optimize token economics, and maximize return on AI investments. The company operates through three segments: Advanced Computing, Integrated Memory, and Optimized LED. The Advanced Computing segment provides AI and high-performance computing solutions …
